title: Jeffrey Kripal's night experience sharing a room with Whitley Strieber at Esalen

tellings.quote: Jeffrey Kriel um who co-authored a book with Whitley tells about the time they shared a room together at the Eselin Institute and uh in the middle of the night Jeffrey had this experience and all he could think was oh my god like this is real and it's happening now

plain: A researcher named Jeffrey Mishlove, speaking on a podcast, passes on a story from Jeffrey Kripal, who co-wrote a book with the writer Whitley Strieber. According to Mishlove, Kripal and Strieber once shared a room at the Esalen Institute, a retreat center in Big Sur, California. In the middle of the night Kripal had an experience that left him thinking only, "oh my god, this is real and it's happening now," which, if true, would suggest that whatever surrounds Strieber is real.
